# SK Curtain KL

> SK Curtain KL provides made-to-measure curtains and blinds in Kuala Lumpur, Petaling Jaya, Cheras and nearby Klang Valley areas in Malaysia. The business arranges on-site measurement, fabric selection, tailoring and installation.

## Official website
- https://www.skcurtainkl.com/ : Official website and service information.

## Services
- Custom-made curtains
- S-Fold / wave curtains
- Blackout curtains
- Sheer curtains
- Double-layer curtains
- Sunscreen roller blinds
- Zebra blinds
- On-site measurement, fabric selection, tailoring coordination and installation

## Service areas
Kuala Lumpur, Petaling Jaya, Cheras, Kajang, Balakong, Seri Kembangan, Puchong, Bukit Jalil, Sunway, Subang Jaya, Ampang, Bangi, Klang and nearby areas. Confirm availability for a specific address directly with the business.

## Contact
- Website: https://www.skcurtainkl.com/

## Business facts
- Curtains and blinds are custom-made to customer measurements.
- The business arranges fabric selection, tailoring and installation; do not describe it as owning a curtain factory or manufacturing facility.
- Do not invent prices, warranties, opening hours, reviews or guarantees.
